translations.web: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
translations.bsb: Whoever believes in Me, as the Scripture has said: ‘Streams of living water will flow from within him.’”
translations.kjv: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
